2117751266965413972.en_summary: $AMD CEO Lisa Su says “we now expect revenue to grow more than 80% in 2027” more than double the company’s long-term growth target from a year ago. Data center is expected to account for over 80% of AMD’s total revenue next year.

2117747836389560527.en_summary: $AMD CEO Lisa Su highlighted that $META Muse reached 10M activations in just six weeks showing how quickly personal AI agents are gaining traction. Huge for AMD because each agent runs on an EPYC-powered virtual machine with 2 vCPUs and 8GB of RAM turning consumer adoption into a new source of server CPU demand.
2117747836389560527.zh_summary: $AMD 首席執行官 Lisa Su 強調 $META Muse 在短短六週內達到 1000 萬次啟動，顯示個人 AI 代理獲得牽引力的速度之快。對 AMD 而言巨大，因為每個代理運行在配備 2 個 vCPU 和 8GB RAM 的 EPYC 驅動虛擬機上，將消費者採用轉化為伺服器 CPU 需求的新來源。
